habit.en: A lot of food culture is about habits and expectations.
habit.zh: 很多饮食文化都与习惯和期望有关。

habit.en: But if your grandparents learned to cook during food rationing, your parents would have grown up eating simple meals, and those habits continue and get transferred down society.
habit.zh: 但如果你的祖父母是在食物配给期间学会烹饪的，你的父母就会在吃简单饭菜的环境中长大，而这些习惯会延续并代代相传。
